audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem ComparatorChecks.epsilon_cost.{u} (R : Type u) [Ring R] (ε : Real) (hε : LT.lt 0 ε) :
  Exists fun C =>
    And (LT.lt 0 C)
      (∀ (n : Nat),
        LE.le 1 n →
          Exists fun P =>
            And (OAI.MatrixMultiplication.Arithmetic.MatrixAlgorithm.Correct P)
              (LE.le (↑(OAI.MatrixMultiplication.Arithmetic.MatrixAlgorithm.cost P))
                (HMul.hMul C (HPow.hPow (↑n) (HAdd.hAdd (9 / 4) ε)))))
audit_declarations.name: ComparatorChecks.epsilon_cost

audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem ComparatorChecks.exact_coefficients (ε : Real) (hε : LT.lt 0 ε) :
  Exists fun n =>
    Exists fun r =>
      And (LE.le 2 n)
        (And (LE.le (↑r) (HPow.hPow (↑n) (HAdd.hAdd (9 / 4) ε)))
          (Exists fun a =>
            Exists fun b =>
              Exists fun c =>
                ∀ (x y z : Prod (Fin n) (Fin n)),
                  Eq
                    (ite
                      (And (Eq (Prod.snd x) (Prod.fst y))
                        (And (Eq (Prod.snd y) (Prod.fst z)) (Eq (Prod.snd z) (Prod.fst x))))
                      1 0)
                    (Finset.sum Finset.univ fun i => HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (a i x) (b i y)) (c i z))))
audit_declarations.name: ComparatorChecks.exact_coefficients
